title: Grant opportunity query
description: Search active Grants.gov opportunities and preserve a baseline for later change checks.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: A Grants.gov keyword or phrase such as artificial intelligence, small business, health, or nonprofit.

statuses.title: Opportunity statuses
statuses.description: Search current posted opportunities, forecasts, or both.

agencyCodes.title: Agency codes
agencyCodes.description: Optional Grants.gov agency codes such as NSF or HHS-NIH11.

eligibilityCodes.title: Eligibility codes
eligibilityCodes.description: Optional two-digit Grants.gov applicant eligibility codes, for example 23 for small businesses.

fundingCategoryCodes.title: Funding category codes
fundingCategoryCodes.description: Optional Grants.gov funding activity category codes.

limit.title: Maximum opportunities
limit.description: Maximum number of current search results to compare with the monitor baseline.

monitorId.title: Monitor ID
monitorId.description: A stable ID for this exact query. Reuse it on scheduled runs; use a new ID when filters change.
